scope: Dedicated serialized AssassinShadowBody captures trained effective rank,level,owner bases and raw sunder stats before actual shared-world unit allocation. Original equipment is generated and retained with exact selection/allocation witnesses and hand identity;the owner items remain original and equipped.

The existing stat graph composes current-helper birth lists with the qualified older resource callback before original item replay. FP256 life/mana/stamina and saved base regeneration use existing resource ledgers and source numeric writers;reconstruction repeats no native pool setters or birth resource callbacks.

One explicit actor stream uses the existing NPC RNG ledger with an additive species binding. Missing Shadow/Valkyrie streams refuse automatic reseeding. A shared original-hand utility preserves the Valkyrie witness shape;old saves omit the additive null fields unchanged.

The optional CanActivate capability defaults true for existing minions. The incomplete Shadow controller opts out,so ordinary roster restore/resume/guarding cannot expose an inert partial fighter. Its original pools still support saves,source difficulty rescale,explicit roster healing and no parked recovery.
limits: No NPC skill-list assignment/mode/permission/event execution,AI105/106,UMod42 registration/death effects,ordinary contact/item procs,learned casting/payment/input or active-world controller. InitialSkillRequests are source metadata,not executed NPC skills. Source item skill/event/aura/charge fields are retained without activating those consumers.

Resource admission requires the original parked body and exact birth/loadout;it does not weaken the generic resource-only unsupported-stat guard or activate incomplete item events. Time-dependent items still require an explicit clock and may refuse whole candidate creation without filtering rolls.

Current unit-stat setter/callback ABI parity and full outer current initializer remain separately unverified. Nonzero inherited sunder is retained but has no admitted offensive consumer. The Valkyrie pre-equipment regeneration recipe merits its own follow-up audit;its existing birth/resource values are unchanged. Effects/appearance/audio and tree/hotkey icons remain separate placeholders.
